title: Anti-neoplastic pharmacophore benzophenone-1 coumarin (BP-1C) targets JAK2 to induce apoptosis in lung cancer.
authors: Sherapura, Ankith; Malojirao, Vikas H; Thirusangu, Prabhu; Sharath, B S; Kandagalla, Shivananda; Vigneshwaran, V; Novak, Jurica; Ranganatha, Lakshmi; Ramachandra, Y L; Baliga, Shrinath M; Khanum, Shaukath Ara; Prabhakar, B T
journal: Apoptosis : an international journal on programmed cell death
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦小分子BP-1C抑制JAK2激酶诱导肺癌凋亡，属于药物-蛋白互作，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且方法仅为常规分子模拟，与本课题无关。
abstract: Reigning of the abnormal gene activation associated with survival signalling in lung cancer leads to the anomalous growth and therapeutic failure. Targeting specific cell survival signalling like JAK2/STAT3 nexus has become a major focus of investigation to establish a target specific treatment. The 2-bromobenzoyl-4-methylphenoxy-acetyl hydra acetyl Coumarin (BP-1C), is new anti-neoplastic agent with apoptosis inducing capacity. The current study was aimed to develop antitumor phramacophore, BP-1C as JAK2 specific inhibitor against lung neoplastic progression. The study validates and identifies the molecular targets of BP-1C induced cell death. Cell based screening against multiple cancer cell lines identified, lung adenocarcinoma as its specific target through promotion of apoptosis. The BP-1C is able to induce, specific hall marks of apoptosis and there by conferring anti-neoplastic activity. Validation of its molecular mechanism, identified, BP-1C specifically targets JAK2(Tyr1007/1008) phosphorylation, and inhibits its downstream STAT3(Tyr705) signalling pathway to induce cell death. As a consequence, modulation in Akt/Src survival signal and altered expression of interwoven apoptotic genes were evident. The results were reproducible in an in-vivo LLC tumor model and in-ovo xenograft studies. The computational approaches viz, drug finger printing confers, BP-1C as novel class JAK2 inhibitor and molecular simulations studies assures its efficiency in binding with JAK2. Overall, BP-1C is a novel JAK2 inhibitor with experimental evidence and could be effectively developed into a promising drug for lung cancer treatment.
abstract_zh: 肺癌中与生存信号相关的异常基因激活的持续存在导致异常生长和治疗失败。靶向特定的细胞生存信号，如JAK2/STAT3轴，已成为建立靶向特异性治疗的主要研究焦点。2-溴苯甲酰-4-甲基苯氧基-乙酰肼乙酰香豆素（BP-1C）是一种具有凋亡诱导能力的新型抗肿瘤药物。本研究旨在开发抗肿瘤药效团BP-1C作为JAK2特异性抑制剂，以对抗肺癌进展。研究验证并鉴定了BP-1C诱导细胞死亡的分子靶点。针对多种癌细胞系的细胞筛选表明，其通过促进凋亡特异性靶向肺腺癌。BP-1C能够诱导凋亡的特异性标志，从而赋予抗肿瘤活性。对其分子机制的验证表明，BP-1C特异性靶向JAK2（Tyr1007/1008）磷酸化，并抑制其下游STAT3（Tyr705）信号通路以诱导细胞死亡。因此，Akt/Src生存信号的调节及交织凋亡基因表达的改变显而易见。这些结果在体内LLC肿瘤模型和卵内异种移植研究中得到重现。计算方法，如药物指纹图谱，表明BP-1C是一种新型JAK2抑制剂，分子模拟研究确保其与JAK2结合的高效性。总体而言，BP-1C是一种具有实验证据的新型JAK2抑制剂，有望有效开发为肺癌治疗的有前景药物。
